name: B10-0231/2026 (ECR) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Venezuela's Amnesty Law, which was passed in February 2026 and then ended early by the acting president in April 2026. The Parliament says the law helped some people but left at least 473 still held, and it calls on Venezuela's authorities to release all political prisoners, restore independent courts and hold free and fair elections.

- No law changes; Parliament calls for releasing all political prisoners in Venezuela.
- Affects detained people, including Europeans and dual nationals, and exiled Venezuelans.
- Next: the EU should watch events closely when deciding on sanctions and relations.
